meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一篇文章或一个选题,变成图文并茂的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有文字稿或选题,想快速做成能直接发布的解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn an article or topic into a graphics-and-text explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a script or topic and want a publishable explainer video fast

howto.what: Claude 会把一段文本(文章、笔记、主题或简报)做成无真人出镜的解说视频,画面按场景现造——排版、抽象图形、图表、数据可视化,没有网站或实拍素材可采集。
howto.when: 当你给出一篇文章、笔记或某个主题,要做主题解说、概念拆解、操作指南等视频时触发;若视频要从网站生成,则走 /product-launch-video,意图不明走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇讲复利的文章做成无真人出镜的解说视频
say.note: 先出故事板,你确认后才建帧渲染

say.text: 用我这份笔记做一个概念拆解视频,旁白用男声
把这个主题做成操作指南解说视频,大概两分钟
say.note: 时长按简报里的 length 设定

howto.what_en: Claude turns text — an article, notes, a topic or a brief — into a faceless explainer video. Every visual is invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz); no site capture or real footage.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give an article, notes or a topic for a topic explainer, concept breakdown or how-to. A video built from a website goes to /product-launch-video; unclear goes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video
say_en.note: You approve the storyboard before frames are built

say_en.text: Make a concept-breakdown video from these notes, male narration
say_en.note: The narration voice is picked at the start

say_en.text: Turn this topic into a how-to explainer, about two minutes long
say_en.note: Length follows the brief's length setting
